item.title: Anger, Laughter And Survival: A Dalit feminist Reading Of Bama’s Karukku

item.title: No Age For Learning: Re-reading Rassundari Devi’s Amar Jibon And The Politics Of Late-life Education
item.description: 'Amar Jibon' disrupts dominant ideologies that link learning to youth and equate education with institutional advantage, thereby introducing a subversive, embodied, and fundamentally feminist pedagogy.
